'''Underworld Logistics''' was a branch of the [[Eternal Alliance]] that worked with the criminal underworld to supply the Alliance's forces and gather intelligence. It was led by [[Hylo Visz]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
